summary:
Most of this week's sessions on the pop-os box went into homelab infrastructure: the GPU serialization broker is fully operational, with SillyTavern confirmed working end-to-end against both the text-gen and image-gen backends through a single coordination point. Lock logic was tightened after a reload-storm regression — the fix enumerates specific mutating endpoints rather than trying to maintain an allowlist of safe paths.

The inference stack is otherwise stable. KoboldCpp, ComfyUI, and the Hermes voice services each have working idle-unload configurations, and the broker handles eviction for concurrent requests without OOM.

On the phillipsben side, a heavy content pass this week: résumé rewritten with a Solutions Architect title and IT/OT integration lead, five project pages published and featured, and honest bio copy committed. The daily dashboard refresh is running each morning and this tile now updates from the pop-os memory snapshot. (snapshot stale, last sync 2026-05-19)

highlights.oneLiner: Résumé, bio, and five project pages shipped in one pass — site now has real content depth.
Daily cron stable; pop-os snapshot pipeline live and writing this tile each morning.
